attribution: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5BW33
page_feature_count_note: Dataset page header says '# Features 6' while the variables table lists 8 columns; the file itself is authoritative (8 columns verified).

rfm.scoring: Percentile-rank 1–5 scores (ties share a score); R inverted; rfm_code = R·100 + F·10 + M; rfm_score = R+F+M (3–15). Scores are relative to this customer base.

k_selection_rule: k = argmax silhouette over k = 2..8; if two k values are within 0.01 of silhouette, pick the smaller k

kmeans.decider: KMeans is the SOLE decider of segment assignment (plan §2.0); RFM scores name/explain; SBC is a cross-check

sbc.note: Exact theoretical cut-offs are 4/3 and 0.5 (Kostenko & Hyndman); 1.32/0.49 is the SBC-published rounded convention

agreement_method: Greedy best one-to-one segment↔quadrant mapping over multi-order customers only (Single-order excluded); agreement = matched ÷ multi-order customers

manual_validation.method: Independent recomputation straight from data/raw/data.csv with plain pandas (not src.rfm/src.clustering): same cleaning order, snapshot 2011-12-10, calendar-date Recency.
manual_validation.note: An earlier Timedelta.days Recency gave R=1 for customer 14646 (hand: 2); fixed to calendar-date difference in src/rfm.py compute_rfm, then re-validated exact.
